name: Quota Monitor
description: Queries API subscription quota / balance for Volcengine Ark, Zhipu, Kimi, MiniMax, ZenMux, OpenCode Go and generic relays, shown in the bottom-left widget.

params.purpose: Query platform control-plane usage APIs (Volcengine OpenAPI, Zhipu quota, Kimi usages, MiniMax remains, OpenCode Go usage).

commands.title: Quota Monitor: check quota now
commands.description: Refresh and show a quota summary dialog for every configured platform.

properties.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
properties.description: How often to re-query quota. 0 disables auto-refresh (manual refresh via the command only).

properties.title: Volcengine Ark inference base URL
properties.description: Used only to derive the OpenAPI region (e.g. https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com -> cn-beijing). The quota API itself always hits open.volcengineapi.com.

properties.title: Volcengine Access Key ID
properties.description: ACCOUNT-LEVEL key (console top-right account menu -> API access keys). NOT the inference bearer key — the OpenAPI gateway rejects the inference key. Stored plaintext in the plugin data dir.

properties.title: Volcengine Secret Access Key
properties.description: ACCOUNT-LEVEL secret paired with the Access Key ID above. Stored plaintext in the plugin data dir.

properties.title: Windows shown in the widget
properties.description: Subset of fiveHour, weekly, monthly, daily. Empty = the standard three (5h / weekly / monthly; daily is hidden in the official console).

properties.title: Zhipu base URL
properties.description: Used to pick the quota host: open.bigmodel.cn (CN) or api.z.ai (EN).

properties.title: Zhipu API key
properties.description: Sent as the raw Authorization header (Zhipu does not use a Bearer prefix). Stored plaintext in the plugin data dir.

properties.title: Kimi API key
properties.description: Queries https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1/usages with a Bearer token.

properties.title: MiniMax API key
properties.description: Queries the MiniMax coding-plan remains endpoint with a Bearer token.

properties.title: ZenMux base URL
properties.description: The Zen relay coding endpoint (quota is queried on the same host). Fetched DIRECTLY from the plugin so any gateway host works.

properties.title: OpenCode Go API key
properties.description: Queries https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage with a Bearer token.

properties.title: Generic relay display name
properties.description: Short tag shown in the widget / command output.

properties.title: Generic relay usage/balance URL
properties.description: Full HTTPS URL of a relay endpoint returning balance (OpenAI-style total_balance/balance) or usage windows (five_hour/weekly/monthly with percent or used/quota). Fetched DIRECTLY from the plugin (not the host broker) so any host works.

properties.title: Generic relay bearer token
properties.description: Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Leave empty for unauthenticated endpoints.
